|errata_history=This is the original printed state of the card, titled •Booster's Star Destroyer (V). The image is the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-02-Errant_Venture.png]]), which prints it. The later version [[Errant Venture]] (PC-E1, the current card) has the same game text under the title •Errant Venture.
* '''Original''' (this page): printed as “•Booster's Star Destroyer (V)” on the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012), p. 8<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=8 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 8, slip 46 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>, and listed under that title, with the same text, on the PC website card list from 21 July 2012 to 11 January 2013<ref name="cl-old-errant">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; Virtual Master list (VMasterType), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064754/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211203905/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111135545/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “May add 6 pilots. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Unless your [Reflections II] objective on table, once per game may ▼ a non-[Maintenance] scoundrel aboard and while Corran or a Terrik piloting, immune to attrition < 7.” (The sheet's heading over the slip reads “•Booster's Star Destroyer (V)”; the card's own title bar has no “(V)”.) The card list spells out the ▼ (“may deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”, icon notation only) and adds a comma after “once per game”; that comma alone waits for a ruling, so it is not a separate version.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Errant Venture]]): On 29 January 2013 the [[Players Committee]] announced the persona-name change “Boosters Star Destroyer ---> Errant Venture”, effective immediately (old slips stayed tournament-legal; non-gameplay lore was removed; “Each of the cards will retain their gametext and characteristics”)<ref name="persona2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 New Persona Changes], [[Players Committee]], 29 January 2013. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003512/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=350&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref>. The title changed to “•Errant Venture”; the game text did not change. The PC website card list shows the new title by 13 March 2013 (the last capture with the old title is of 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-new-errant">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130313222931/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-03-13], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429063548/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-04-29]; VMasterType, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20130314003713/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-03-14], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130429102413/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VMasterType.html 2013-04-29] (Internet Archive; these captures carry no game text)</ref>, and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, PDF page 49)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=49, page 49. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=49 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the card as •Errant Venture. The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-45-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-errantventure-pre.gif]], undated) print it.
